name: Trek North
summary: A trekking company website for northern Pakistan: trips, route maps, jeep seats, gear, guides and booking
about: A nine-page website for a small trekking company in Hunza, Skardu and Fairy Meadows, in glacier blue, pine and sunrise orange. On the home page an altitude profile draws itself as you scroll while a small hiker climbs it camp by camp, and every departure shows its twelve seats filling on two jeeps. Trips have day-by-day plans with a route map, and the gear list, guides, safety tools, reviews and a four-step booking with a PKR deposit all work.
how: Scroll the home page to walk the altitude profile, or press Watch the climb; switch between three treks
Filter trips by region, grade, length and month, then open one to follow the day-by-day plan on the map
Watch seats fill on the jeeps on the home page and the live Dates and seats page; join a waitlist when a date is full
Book in four steps: pick a date, tap your seats on the jeep, add extras and pay a 25% deposit
Tick off the gear list, rent items and watch the duffel weight; request a guide by name
Check a trip's sleeping heights and the altitude sickness guide on the Safety page
Press Ctrl+K to search trips, guides and pages; reset demo data from the footer
